title: Manasukkul Oru Mazhaicharal
overview: The hero Nakulan is on his way back home enjoying all the changes his village has undergone since he had travelled after for higher studies. He makes a surprise entry and brings in smile in his parents and sisters face. He gives all the gifts which he has bought for them and keeps aside the parcel he had bought for his lover Arthi. After that he goes in search of his school friend Muthu who has his own shop in the market and after that happens to meet his girlfriend and conveys his love for her and she rejects the same. Arthi who is the bread winner for her family rejects Nakuls love, but later situations make her realize his true love and they get united. The situations which bring them together is being neatly showcased in the movie Manasukkul Oru Mazhaicharal.
